originality.rationale: The new statement is the sharp signed comparison of symmetric block-Jacobi condition numbers to the original rank-one spike in a three-block equal-pair energy family, including its exact two-curve boundary and sharp 3/2 ratio cap. The closest two-block eigenpairing is expressly attributed to prior literature, and the general scaling and recent BLOKS papers inspected do not directly entail the claimed complete region and cap. Dedicated searches of published mathematical findings found no matching claim; this is not uniqueness proof and residual original-source access risks remain.
residual_risks: The 2002 Kolotilina general block-scaling paper was not inspected in full; a specialized existing characterization cannot be excluded.
The 2023 Demmel article was not inspected in full, although the main stated theorem has different quantifiers; an implicit special-case computation might exist.
The complete 2026 BLOKS text could not be directly opened; relevant Appendix B material was read from its indexed full-text rendering.
The boundary and factor concern a two-equal-energy rank-one three-block family, not all three-block problems.
